text: MimeMessage uses fromHdr[0]?.email to extract the hostname when a parsed From address is available and still calls msgGenerateMessageId when it is missing. It no longer indexes an empty array unconditionally. Preserve the optional parsed-address boundary rather than adding a separate UI assumption that From always exists. The native generator may fall back or leave message ID generation to the protocol. This source fix was inspected; a missing-From message was not sent. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.
title: Missing From is handled at the parsed-address boundary in MIME construction
